TOOLING BURST FL-4a — fire lane round 4a: FASTER burst, burn-down into embers + white-hot afterglow, projectile core + trail on the existing paintings (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; Matt R-C5-109 — "the flame/explosion needs to be faster and speeding up to the particles"; "the burn down at the end is too slow and looks like a residual decal"; "the white hot center is the best piece"). task_id "FL-4a".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4h (burst_v2 + key states), T4q, FL-2, FL-3, FL-3b and the new row "FL-4a — faster burst · burn-down into embers · white-hot afterglow · projectile core + trail" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (burst_v2 pieces phase: hold/expanded/spent key states, residue, erosion; the FL-3 additive core, boil, embers, contact light, shimmer sheet; the G1 painted projectile: head/streak, flicker, trail motes), export/effect_kit.py, export/vfx_material.gdshader, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/kit.json, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json (+ _A), runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

PART A — TEMPO (the whole burst faster, accelerating into particles). New pieces timing (kit fields, validated): contact flash 2 f (unchanged) → pieces fly at 1400 → 2000 px/s (`base_speed_px_s`), expanded key state at age 12 (was 19) with hold 2 f (was 3), erosion outside-in begins at age 14 and completes by age 26 (was ~40), spent key state at age 24 with hold 2 f (was 6) — i.e. peak-to-spent 12 frames, not 21; `residue_s` 0.8 → 0.35; residue_fraction 0.2 → 0.12. Total painted life ≤ 0.6 s (36 f) from contact. Trace clause: ages of expanded/spent/residue-end; painted pixel count at age 30 ≤ 15 % of the peak's.
PART B — THE LIVING-EMBER ENDING (Matt R-C5-110: "we have already done the end of a fire — the living embers inside each burning tree"). REMOVE the painted residue entirely: after the spent key state (age 24 + 2 f) no painted pixel of the burst remains — no residue hold, no erosion smear, no decal. In its place the burst ENDS as a LARGE version of the scene's living embers, built from the SAME recipe the props layer uses for the burning trees (export/props_layer.py: the `crack_embers_*` particles — fx/ember_1.png sprites, additive, colour_start [1,.85,.5,1] → colour_end [1,.25,.05,0], rise with spread 28°, slight negative gravity, angular velocity, scale_curve 1→.3 — and the GlowFlicker additive glow disc fx/glow.png, colour [1,.45,.12,.85], flicker 4.7 Hz × .35): reuse those textures/scripts, do not paint new ones. Sizing = the old decal ending: emission rect = the burst footprint ≈ 1.8 BH wide × 0.9 BH tall (ground ellipse) at the contact point; amount 48 (props trees use 10 over a 12-px rect); lifetime 1.0–1.6 s; velocity 30–90 px/s; sprite scale 3× the tree embers (0.15–0.33); one-shot emission over 0.5 s starting at age 20 (overlapping the spent state) so the sparks are already rising as the painting leaves; the glow disc radius 0.9 BH, α .85 at age 22 decaying to 0 by age 22 + 1.2 s with an ease-out, flickering at 4.7 Hz throughout; plus the FL-3 white-hot core kept as a 0.45-BH cream additive disc decaying over 0.6 s (the "white-hot centre" Matt named the best piece). Kit fields `pieces.ember_ending {{amount 48, rect_bh [1.8, .9], life_s [1.0,1.6], speed_px_s [30,90], scale [.15,.33], glow_radius_bh .9, glow_alpha .85, glow_s 1.2, core_radius_bh .45, core_s .6}}` validated with ranges; `residue_s` becomes 0 and residue_fraction is ignored when ember_ending is present (validate: mutually exclusive with a painted residue). Trace clause: no painted burst pixel after age 26; ember births = 48 within ages 20–50; glow alpha samples at 22 / 40 / 60 / 94; total effect life (last live ember) ≤ 1.9 s from contact.

PART C — PROJECTILE (the bolt gets the impact's care, on the existing paintings; new paintings bind in FL-4b): (C0) SPEED (Matt R-C5-111: use the Hades in-game projectile speeds): the fire bolt's `mechanics.speed_px_s` 1040 → 1510 (the Hades Zeus-cast class, 1600 u/s = 11.6 BH/s at 130 px/BH; Legolas O7 VERIFIED); travel time over the 520-px range 0.5 → 0.34 s (`phase_envelope_s.travel` .34); streak/trail lengths unchanged in px (the streak's aspect grows with speed — P17); provenance line naming the Hades class. Apply to both fire arms; ice unchanged. (C1) additive white-hot CORE on the head in flight — the head's band-3 plane drawn additive at α .7 with a 4-px blur, pulsing ×1.0–1.08 at 8 Hz; (C2) a heat halo on the head (glow α .3 ×1.2); (C3) the trail: the streak becomes a boiling body — erosion-noise UV drift 0.5/s along the streak, erode oscillation ±0.08 at 8 Hz, plus the ember trail rate 5 → 12/s, size 3–5 px, life .45 s, band 3/2; (C4) a faint additive light streak (band-2, α .2) 1 BH long behind the head fading over 6 frames (motion smear). Fields under `travel.*`, validated, defaults off (ice byte-identical). Trace clause: core node additive with sampled alpha/scale per frame; trail mote rate; streak uniforms differ every frame.
PART D — byte locks re-opened by the emitted-scene change: re-baseline only with per-lock diff summaries (FL-1b rule); the catalogue lock stays red (E3-r1) — name it.

Apply the new fields to runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (provenance "R-C5-109 FL-4a") and the three fire kits' kit.json; primitives byte-identical.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-4a/acceptance.json): the trace clauses with numbers; 14 kits byte-identical; full 17-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0 (gl_compatibility); in-sandbox suite with the named tests green, remaining reds NAMED with the last traceback line.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): the timing/afterglow/projectile clauses; field validations; extend only. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit except the three fire kits' kit.json, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-4a/ and runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (named fields); fixtures/ only for Part D. Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-5/t3/FL-4a/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-4a"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
